There's no single number I can give you. How much is too much depends on your body, your total diet and any medical history, so a doctor or registered dietitian is the right person for an amount.

In general terms, powder is a convenience, not a requirement. Most people do fine getting the bulk of their protein from regular food and using a scoop to fill gaps. If you're leaning on shakes to the point that real meals are getting squeezed out, that's usually a sign to rebalance.

If you want, I can pull up some high-protein recipes from the app so food does more of the work.
